name: PangeaBench-multilingual-llava-bench
description: PangeaBench-multilingual-llava-bench is a multilingual, multimodal evaluation suite intended to test LLaVA-style vision-language models across languages and tasks. It contains multimodal prompts and examples for tasks such as visual question answering and captioning in multiple languages, enabling cross-lingual V&L performance comparison. The benchmark reports task-specific metrics (e.g., accuracy for VQA, BLEU for captioning).
evaluation_method: Accuracy / exact_match for VQA-style tasks; BLEU (or other n-gram/text metrics) for captioning; task-specific accuracy metrics for grounding
general_score_metric: Task-dependent (accuracy/exact_match for VQA; BLEU/CIDEr for captioning)
reputation: Part of the PangeaBench family and hosted on Hugging Face; a growing resource for multilingual multimodal evaluation but with limited widespread citation compared to flagship benchmarks.
